props.description:
The top-level entries, in order. An entry with `children` is a button that opens a panel of its children's links
(with their `description` and `icon`); any other entry is a link.
props.name: items

props.description: The landmark's name; defaults to the catalogue's "Main navigation". Name it when a page has two.
props.name: label

props.description: The panel's columns: 1 (the default) or 2, for a mega menu of many links.
props.name: columns
